episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Retired assassin Julie and her estranged son Edward are forced to work together in a fight for survival, testing their dysfunctional relationship to its limits.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Julie and Edward must maintain a cover and keep Julie's past hidden from their new hosts, but a surprise arrival only complicates things further.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: A wedge is driven between the group but answers are close and they must press on as the danger and threat to their lives closes in.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Across Europe, news breaks about the tragedy Julie and Edward witnessed on the island, and they become the targets of a police manhunt.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: The pieces finally start falling into place for Julie – does she know who might be responsible for the catastrophic trail of events?

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: As a dramatic final showdown prepares to take place, shocking truths are revealed to Edward that make him question everything he thought he knew about his life
